messages:
nina (Docs): FYI opened PR to add a small migration section + CLI + SDK examples for audit export/purge. Need quick legal/security check before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5378
cale (Security): Thanks. Two asks: use 'customer' not 'tenant' in public copy, and add a short caveat that purge/deletion requests may be delayed by lawful holds or backup retention cycles.
rachel (Legal): Draft wording: "Redwood retains audit logs per the customer's retention policy. Export and deletion requests will be fulfilled, subject to lawful holds and contractual obligations." Approve that for public docs.
nina (Docs): Will use that wording. Also switching TTL examples to ISO-8601 durations (P30D, P90D) and adding a tiny mapping table for SDK name changes.
den (DevEx): I'll add examples for CLI, Python, and the new Rust SDK pattern. Quick question: should we show both streaming (compress) and paged flows?
tom (SDK): Both please. Note SDK method names changed in v0.9: old `export_logs` -> `audit.export`, old `purge_logs` -> `audit.purge`. Include code mapping and migration note.
olga (QA): Add a sample redacted JSONL line so customers see the payload: `{"timestamp":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z","event":"login","user_id":"acct_88","redacted":true}` and a note that redacted exports are irreversible.
den (DevEx): CLI compressed export sample I added:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?since=2026-09-01&format=jsonl&compress=true&page_size=1000" --output audit-2026-09.jsonl.gz
# server returns X-Export-Digest: sha256:<hex> for checksum verification
```
den (DevEx): Python paged example:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=TOKEN)
for page in client.audit.export(since='2026-09-01', format='jsonl', page_size=200):
    print(page)
```
Tom (SDK): Rust streaming example (new v0.9 style):
```rust
let client = redwood_rs::Client::new("$TOKEN");
let mut s = client.audit().export_stream("since=2026-09-01&format=jsonl&compress=true").await?;
while let Some(chunk) = s.next().await {
  println!("{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&chunk?));
}
```
cale (Security): Add a short bullet under examples: "Purge requests are processed but may not remove data from backups/archives immediately; contact support for special retention/purge requests."
rachel (Legal): LGTM. Also prefer 'fulfilled' instead of 'processed' in public-facing sentence — Nina, please use the exact phrasing above.
nina (Docs): Updated wording to Rachel's preferred sentence and pushed commit. Added migration table: `export_logs -> audit.export`, `purge_logs -> audit.purge`. Also added a tiny changelog note pointing to SDK releases.
olga (QA): Quick QA check: add retry guidance for large exports (resume with page_token instead of restarting). I left a quick note in the PR.
den (DevEx): Added page_token resume snippet and guidance about conservative page_size for memory.
tom (SDK): Thx. I'll cut an SDK patch note to highlight the method rename and link to docs.
nina (Docs): Great — merging after CI. Will follow up in #eng-runtime if any follow-up SDK clarifications are requested. Thanks all :raised_hands:
